Welcome to the Cuck Factory. Your shift starts now

Claim your CUCKDROP now

Hold the coin, get paid in stocks. The Index turns trading activity into real stock ownership. Every time $INDEX is traded, a 3% fee is collected in ETH and used to buy a basket of 18 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Those stocks are sent straight to holders' wallets — automatically, onchain, every 15 minutes. No claiming, no staking. The more the coin is traded, the more stocks the community owns.

Robinhood HIMS is a tokenized representation of Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (HIMS) common stock, issued on Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's own blockchain built to bring tokenized real-world assets on-chain. Each token is designed to track the price of the underlying HIMS share, giving holders on-chain price exposure to Hims & Hers Health, Inc.'s stock. The token is freely transferable and composable across the Robinhood Chain ecosystem. Raeto is an app on Robinhood Chain that pays for AI with the interest your assets earn. Deposit tokenized stocks or USDG into Raeto vaults, which lend through Morpho; the interest becomes AI credits for 400+ models, while you keep your deposit. Auto routing sends each request to the cheapest model that can handle it, and rCREDIT turns AI credits into a token backed 1:1 by USDG. Raeto supports autonomous AI agents. An agent can sign in with its own wallet to receive an API key, or pay per request onchain using USDG or rCREDIT, without a human-managed account.

Bundlecat (BUN) is the first token launched on Mosh, a token launch protocol developed by UV Labs and deployed on Robinhood Chain. Mosh pairs new token launches with autonomous AI market-making agents. Under the Mosh model, token bundles are crowd-funded by participants and permanently locked in non-custodial smart contract vaults at the moment of launch. AI agents then use the locked tokens to provide liquidity and generate buy-side market activity, operating within contract-enforced rules that no individual, including the Mosh team, can override. FLock.io is a decentralised AI model training and validation network. It breaks down the walled gardens of model creation and development from the few tech companies by making compute, data contribution, and training composable. The team consists of cutting-edge researchers, including several CS PhDs from the University of Oxford. It is backed by leading investors: DCG, Lightspeed Faction, Volt, Tagus, OKX Ventures, etc.
